name: anti-meeting
description: Local macOS-only meeting recorder (with cross-platform history browsing) and Markdown notes plugin for Antigravity

scripts.build:server: esbuild mcp-server/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=plugin/scripts/meeting-mcp-server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x plugin/scripts/meeting-mcp-server.mjs
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build:ui && npm run build:server && npm run sync:sources
scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:native && npm run build:swift
